articles.title: Designing an Always-On Agent
articles.summary: Before ChatGPT was released, I used to imagine AI would be something like Jarvis from Iron Man. I imagined it would always be running, it would have a personality, and it would have the same awareness of my environment that I do. But today's chatbots and agents aren't like this. We spin them up for tasks and projects, but if we don't send them a message, nothing happens. They're dry and robotic, and they only know the context we give them. articles.title: Four Bugs, One Day: What a Self-Policing Agent Org Looks Like When It Works
articles.summary: Most engineering blog posts describe a system the authors built. This one describes a system that caught its own bugs. articles.title: VindexLLM – Windows Vulkan GPU GGUF LLM inference engine written in Delphi 12
articles.summary: VindexLLM is a pure Delphi, GPU-powered LLM inference engine that uses Vulkan compute shaders to run GGUF models entirely on the GPU. It performs full transformer inference without relying on Python, CUDA, or other external runtimes, requiring only vulkan-1.dll, which is typically included with modern GPU drivers. VindexLLM is a GPU-accelerated LLM inference engine written entirely in Delphi, using Vulkan compute shaders for all heavy computation. articles.summary: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills. Most agent memory is a black box: text goes in, embeddings come out, and nobody can see what was actually stored. OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem under viking:// instead. articles.title: Uncensored LLMs in agent loops: 31 models, 5 tasks, most fail half the time
articles.summary: We gave every uncensored model tools and five multi-step tasks. Smarter originals finish more, models built on weaker ones loop almost twice as often, and most still fail half the time. Uncensored models are mostly sold on what they will say. We wanted to know what they do: give them tools and a multi-step job, and see whether they finish, go in circles, or fall over.
